name: Revelio Labs Internal
description: Revelio Labs Internal MCP Connector provides Revelio Labs workforce data for internal users

_published_faq.name: How do I add Revelio Labs Internal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Revelio Labs Internal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dash-mcp.prd.cloud.reveliolabs.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Revelio Labs Internal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revelio Labs Internal provides these MCP tools: company_competitors, company_composition, company_details, company_mapper_search, company_pay, company_posting, company_sentiment, company_transitions, selection_list, and taxonomy.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Revelio Labs Internal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Revelio Labs Internal in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Revelio Labs Internal MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revelio Labs Internal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Revelio Labs Internal is developed by Revelio Labs Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
